label: L=9 copy phase, near start/end of recall (recall_idx 1,2,7,8) on inputs m/u/o/p
explanation: Very sparse, tiny-magnitude unit (0.03% of steps, max 0.004). Fires only in the copy phase, never during original input or the delimiter, and almost only in L=9 sequences (97% of mass). Activity is concentrated at two positions, recall_idx 2 (t=11, about 48% of mass) and recall_idx 8 (the final step, t=17, about 31%), with smaller contributions from the steps just before them (recall_idx 1 and 7). It only fires on repeated inputs (in_first=0, which is automatic in the copy phase) and strongly prefers input tokens m, u, o, p (about 90% of mass); a is weaker. Strongest examples are o/u/m/p/a at t=11 or t=17. Position plus token captures about 85% of the mass, but precision is only about 3%: most L=9 steps at these positions with these tokens stay silent, and no prev_tok or history condition I tried pushed precision above about 5%. Magnitude is not explained beyond position and token.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=m (+4.23), phase=2 & in_tok=u (+3.86), phase=2 & in_tok=o (+3.85), phase=2 & in_tok=p (+2.79), phase=2 & out_tok=i (+2.75), prev_tok=n (+2.57).
